security_scope: New offset-half identity is unconditional algebra.
Gaussian validity result is for an ideal centered continuous-Gaussian threshold mechanism; it is not a universal impossibility for all noisy encodings.
Wee and partial-trapdoor source theorems are PPT/classical statements; QPT security is not silently inferred.
The straight-line structure of Wee Theorem 1 is recorded only as a plausible QPT-lift lead under QPT-LWE, requiring formal quantum-game proof.
Hair-Sahai lp hardness is worst-case NP-hardness, not average-case LWE/SIS or a QPT cryptographic hardness assumption.
